# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-action.json
---
name: Pushed paths
description: Report whether the pushed range changed a path that matches a pattern
inputs:
  pattern:
    description: Extended regular expression matched against each changed path
    required: true
outputs:
  matched:
    description: "true when a changed path matches, or when the pushed range is unknown"
    value: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.matched }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Checkout history
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      with: { persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0 }
    - name: Match the pushed range against the pattern
      id: classify
      shell: bash
      env:
        BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        AFTER: ${{ github.event.after || github.sha }}
        PATTERN: ${{ inputs.pattern }}
      run: |
        matched=true
        if [[ -n "${BEFORE}" && "${BEFORE}" != 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ]] && git cat-file -e "${BEFORE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "${BEFORE}" "${AFTER}")
          printf 'Changed files:\n%s\n' "${changed}"
          if ! grep -Eq -- "${PATTERN}" <<< "${changed}"; then
            matched=false
          fi
        fi
        echo "matched=${matched}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        echo "matched: ${matched}"

---
name: autofix.ci
on: { push: { branches: [master] }, pull_request: null }
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.stack == null
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - parallel:
          - uses: kjanat/setup-tombi@94a6834e289046705b32e6b8dc977c8b939e8b35 # v1
            with: { version-file: .tool-versions }
          - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9
            with: { version-file: .tool-versions, install-only: true }
          - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
            with: { go-version-file: go.mod }
          - uses: kjanat/dprint-check@29c42153a7346f4d7315883ff7722cfe22cd510c # Without this action, dprint has to recompile the wasm plugins each time the action runs, which is often, and wastes time, energy, and sanity.
            with: { install-only: true }
      - name: x/tools/go/analysis modernize
        run: go run golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis/passes/modernize/cmd/modernize@latest -fix ./...
      - name: format the code
        run: dprint fmt --allow-no-files --diff --excludes .github # autofix-ci will fail if the .github directory is touched
      - uses: autofix-ci/action@c5b2d67aa2274e7b5a18224e8171550871fc7e4a # v1
        with:
          comment: Applied automated formatting/modernization. Please review the generated commit.
          commit-message: Apply automated formatting and modernization fixes
          fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

---
name: Build
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release:
        description: Build tagged release instead of snapshot.
        type: boolean
        default: false
    outputs:
      artifact:
        description: Uploaded binaries and Debian package.
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.artifact }}
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build udm-iptv Debian package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs: { artifact: build-artifacts }
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sources
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache-dependency-path: go.sum }
      - name: Build binaries and packages
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ case(inputs.release == true, vars.SENTRY_DSN, '') }}
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version-file: .tool-versions
          args: release --clean --skip=publish ${{ case(inputs.release == true, '', '--snapshot') }}
      - name: Materialize binary release asset
        run: install -m 0755 dist/udm-iptv_linux_arm64_v8.0/udm-iptv dist/udm-iptv-linux-arm64
      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: build-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            dist/udm-iptv-linux-arm64
            dist/*.deb
            dist/SHA256SUMS

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push: { branches: [master] }
  workflow_call:
    inputs: { release: { description: "Validate tagged release instead of snapshot.", type: boolean, default: false } }
    outputs: { artifact: { description: "Validated binaries and Debian package.", value: "${{ jobs.build.outputs.artifact }}" } }
concurrency: { group: "ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}", queue: single }
permissions: { contents: &r read }
jobs:
  build:
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml
    with: { release: "${{ inputs.release == true }}" }

  test:
    name: Go tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - &Checkout
        name: Checkout Sources
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - &Go
        name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache-dependency-path: go.sum }
      - name: Test Go
        run: go test -race ./...

  actionlint:
    name: Lint GitHub Actions workflows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps: [*Checkout, { uses: kjanat/actionlint@722799fa4b8cc6734debb97bae24aca9e0dbaf59 }] # v1

  integration:
    name: Integration (${{ matrix.package }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { package: network, test: "Test.*", privileged: true }
          - { package: service, test: "TestProxy(StateFailureReapsProcess|StateAndStop)", privileged: false }
          - { package: service, test: "TestSystemd(Lifecycle|PauseFailureRestoresService)", privileged: true }
          - { package: service, test: "TestSecondDaemonCannotTakeTheIPTVNetwork", privileged: true }
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - parallel:
          - *Go
          - name: Prepare env
            env: { T: "${{ matrix.test }}", F: "${{ runner.temp }}/integration.test", P: "./internal/${{ matrix.package }}" }
            run: '{ echo "FILE=${F}"; echo "TEST=${T}"; echo "PKG=${P}"; } >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"'
      - name: Compile integration tests
        run: go test -c -tags integration -o "${FILE}" "${PKG}"
      - name: Run integration tests
        if: ${{ !matrix.privileged }}
        run: '"${FILE}" -test.run "^${TEST}$" -test.v'
      - name: Run privileged integration tests
        if: ${{ matrix.privileged }}
        run: sudo "${FILE}" -test.run "^${TEST}$" -test.v

  fmt:
    name: Check formatting
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - parallel:
          - *Go
          - name: Install golangci-lint
            uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9
            with: { version-file: &TV .tool-versions, install-only: true }
          - uses: kjanat/setup-tombi@94a6834e289046705b32e6b8dc977c8b939e8b35 # v1
            with: { version-file: *TV }
      - name: Check formatting
        uses: kjanat/dprint-check@29c42153a7346f4d7315883ff7722cfe22cd510c # v3.1.0

  lint:
    name: Lint and vulnerabilities
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: *r, pull-requests: *r }
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - *Go
      - parallel:
          - name: Vet Go
            run: go vet -tags firmware ./...
          - name: Lint Go
            uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9
            with:
              version-file: *TV
              args: --build-tags firmware
              only-new-issues: "${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.repository_owner != github.event.pull_request.head.repo.owner.login }}"
          - name: Check Go vulnerabilities
            run: go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./...
          - name: Lint shell scripts
            run: shellcheck tests/firmware/boot.sh tests/multicast/registration.sh packaging/deb/{config,preinstall,postinstall,preremove,postremove}
          - name: Check Debian script syntax
            working-directory: packaging/deb
            run: for script in config preinstall postinstall preremove postremove; do sh -n "${script}"; done

  package:
    name: Validate package
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - &dlArtefacts
        name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: "${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact }}", path: dist }
      - parallel:
          - name: Verify checksums
            working-directory: dist
            run: sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
          - name: Validate Debian package
            env: { package: dist/udm-iptv-arm64.deb }
            run: |
              test -f "${package}"
              package_name=$(dpkg-deb --field "${package}" Package)
              architecture=$(dpkg-deb --field "${package}" Architecture)
              dependencies=$(dpkg-deb --field "${package}" Depends)
              test "${package_name}" = udm-iptv
              test "${architecture}" = arm64
              grep -Eq '(^|, )improxy(, |$)'  <<<"${dependencies}"
              grep -Eq '(^|, )iptables(, |$)' <<<"${dependencies}"
              control=$(mktemp -d)
              dpkg-deb --control "${package}" "${control}"
              test -x "${control}/config"
              test -x "${control}/preinst"
              test -x "${control}/postinst"
              test -x "${control}/prerm"
              test -x "${control}/postrm"
              test -f "${control}/templates"
              grep -Fq "configure set --profile \"\${profile}\"" "${control}/postinst"
              dpkg-deb --contents "${package}" | grep -E '/data/udm-iptv/bin/udm-iptv$'
              dpkg-deb --contents "${package}" | grep -E '/usr/share/doc/udm-iptv/copyright$'

  changes:
    name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    outputs: { firmware: "${{ steps.classify.outputs.matched }}" }
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - name: Decide whether the firmware suite has to run
        id: classify
        uses: $/.github/actions/pushed-paths
        with: { pattern: '^(cmd/|internal/|tests/|packaging/|patches/|go\.(mod|sum)$|\.github/(workflows/(ci|build)\.yml|actions/pushed-paths/)' }

  catalog:
    name: Resolve published firmware
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.firmware == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: *r, packages: *r }
    outputs: { matrix: "${{ steps.catalog.outputs.matrix }}" }
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - *Go
      - name: Select firmware pairs
        id: catalog
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", GH_REPO: "${{ github.repository }}", IMAGE: "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/unifi-os" }
        run: |
          matrix='{"include":[]}'
          for track in release beta pinned; do
            next=$(go run ./cmd/firmware --track "${track}" published)
            matrix=$(jq -c --argjson next "${next}" --arg track "${track}" \
              '.include += ($next.include | map(. + {track: $track}))' <<< "${matrix}")
          done
          # Identical published image pairs share one test; retain every track label.
          matrix=$(jq -c '.include |= (group_by([.model, .from, .to]) |
            map(.[0] + {tracks: (map(.track) | unique)} | del(.track)))' <<< "${matrix}")
          jq -e '.include | length > 0' <<< "${matrix}" >/dev/null
          printf 'matrix=%s\n' "${matrix}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  firmware:
    name: fw cycle (${{ matrix.model }}, ${{ join(matrix.tracks, '+') }})
    needs: [build, catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy: { fail-fast: false, max-parallel: 6, matrix: "${{ fromJSON(needs.catalog.outputs.matrix) }}" }
    env:
      SRC: ${{ matrix.from }}
      DST: ${{ matrix.to }}
    steps:
      - *Checkout
      - *Go
      - *dlArtefacts
      - name: Test firmware installation, reboot and offline recovery
        env: { UDM_IPTV_FIRMWARE_EVIDENCE: "${{ runner.temp }}/firmware-evidence" }
        run: go test -tags firmware -v -count=1 -timeout=20m ./tests/firmware
      - name: Upload firmware evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: firmware-evidence-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/firmware-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  ci-passed:
    name: CI passed
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [build, test, actionlint, integration, fmt, lint, package, changes, catalog, firmware]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - name: Require every dependency to succeed
        env:
          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          FIRMWARE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.firmware }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "${RESULTS}" | jq -e --arg firmware "${FIRMWARE}" '
            keys == ["actionlint", "build", "catalog", "changes", "firmware", "fmt", "integration", "lint", "package", "test"]
            and all(to_entries[];
              .value.result == "success"
              or ($firmware == "false" and (.key == "catalog" or .key == "firmware") and .value.result == "skipped"))
          '

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Comment Cop
on:
  pull_request: { types: [opened, synchronize, reopened] }
  pull_request_target: { types: [opened, synchronize, reopened] }
permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }
jobs:
  comment-cop:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'kjanat/udm-iptv'
      && (github.event_name == 'pull_request') == (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    concurrency: { group: "comment-cop-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}", cancel-in-progress: false, queue: max }
    steps: [{ name: Run Comment Cop, uses: $/.github/actions/comment-cop }]

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Multicast fixture
run-name: Multicast ${{ inputs.scenario || 'smoke' }}${{ inputs.scenario == 'regression' && format(' {0}', inputs.implementation) || '' }} (${{ github.ref_name }})
on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
    paths: [tests/multicast/**, patches/improxy/**, internal/**, go.mod, go.sum, .github/workflows/multicast.yml]
  pull_request:
    paths: [tests/multicast/**, patches/improxy/**, internal/**, go.mod, go.sum, .github/workflows/multicast.yml]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      scenario:
        description: Experiment to run after the five-second smoke test
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: smoke
        options: [smoke, baseline, lower, higher, recovery, regression]
      implementation:
        description: Implementation for the full regression matrix (other scenarios test all builds)
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: patched
        options: [upstream, patched]
concurrency:
  group: multicast-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}-${{ inputs.scenario || 'smoke' }}-${{ inputs.scenario == 'regression' && inputs.implementation || 'all' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  changes:
    name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    outputs: { relevant: "${{ steps.classify.outputs.matched }}" }
    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Decide whether this push touched the fixture
        id: classify
        uses: $/.github/actions/pushed-paths
        with: { pattern: '^(tests/multicast/|patches/improxy/|internal/|go\.(mod|sum)$|\.github/(workflows/multicast\.yml|actions/pushed-paths/))' }

  smoke:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ inputs.scenario != 'regression' && needs.changes.outputs.relevant == 'true' }}
    name: ${{ inputs.scenario || 'smoke' }} (${{ matrix.name }}, ARM64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: upstream
            implementation: upstream
            firmware-image: ghcr.io/kjanat/unifi-os:udmpro-5.1.33@sha256:5d6138dd461c4d265380eb550f5e609b072268e50205007cdd050d09f1d38bf8
          - name: patched
            implementation: patched
            firmware-image: ghcr.io/kjanat/unifi-os:udmpro-5.1.33@sha256:5d6138dd461c4d265380eb550f5e609b072268e50205007cdd050d09f1d38bf8
          - name: udmpro-5.1.33
            implementation: firmware
            firmware-image: ghcr.io/kjanat/unifi-os:udmpro-5.1.33@sha256:5d6138dd461c4d265380eb550f5e609b072268e50205007cdd050d09f1d38bf8
          - name: ucgmax-5.1.33
            implementation: firmware
            firmware-image: ghcr.io/kjanat/unifi-os:ucgmax-5.1.33@sha256:8d2509449e6f040624725690f1b37d1468f6ac7f6c0af59ffaf58e61f24174fd
    env:
      PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION: ${{ matrix.implementation }}
      FIRMWARE_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.firmware-image }}
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Verify native ARM64 runner and Docker daemon
        run: |
          mkdir -p tests/multicast/artifacts
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            aarch64|arm64) ;;
            *) echo "Expected a native ARM64 runner" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          architecture="$(docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}')"
          case "${architecture}" in
            aarch64|arm64) ;;
            *) echo "Expected a native ARM64 Docker daemon, got ${architecture}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          {
            uname -a
            docker version
            docker compose version
          } | tee tests/multicast/artifacts/runner.txt
      - name: Build fixture and run fixture checks
        run: docker compose -f tests/multicast/compose.yaml build 2>&1 | tee tests/multicast/artifacts/build.log
      - name: Setup Go for service registration regression
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache-dependency-path: go.sum }
      - name: Reject partial proxy startup and verify recovery
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: bash tests/multicast/registration.sh "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}"
      # Automatic runs stop after registration and smoke; longer scenarios require dispatch.
      - name: Run five-second multicast smoke test
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          python3 tests/multicast/run.py smoke \
            --implementation "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" \
            --firmware-image "${FIRMWARE_IMAGE}"
      - name: Run six-minute querier experiment
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.scenario != 'smoke' }}
        timeout-minutes: 8
        env:
          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
        run: |
          python3 tests/multicast/run.py scenario \
            --scenario "${SCENARIO}" --duration 360 \
            --implementation "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" \
            --firmware-image "${FIRMWARE_IMAGE}"
      - name: Upload fixture evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: multicast-${{ inputs.scenario || 'smoke' }}-${{ matrix.name }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: tests/multicast/artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
  regression:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.scenario == 'regression' }}
    name: ${{ inputs.implementation }} / ${{ matrix.scenario }} / IGMPv${{ matrix.version }} (ARM64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scenario: [baseline, lower, higher, recovery]
        version: [2, 3]
    env:
      PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION: ${{ inputs.implementation }}
      SCENARIO: ${{ matrix.scenario }}
      IGMP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.version }}
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Verify native ARM64 runner and Docker daemon
        run: |
          mkdir -p tests/multicast/artifacts
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            aarch64|arm64) ;;
            *) echo "Expected a native ARM64 runner" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          architecture="$(docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}')"
          case "${architecture}" in
            aarch64|arm64) ;;
            *) echo "Expected a native ARM64 Docker daemon, got ${architecture}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          {
            uname -a
            docker version
            docker compose version
          } | tee tests/multicast/artifacts/runner.txt
      - name: Build fixture and run fixture checks
        run: docker compose -f tests/multicast/compose.yaml build 2>&1 | tee tests/multicast/artifacts/build.log
      # Export once per implementation; this container is never started.
      - name: Export tested ARM64 binary and build provenance
        if: ${{ matrix.scenario == 'baseline' && matrix.version == 3 }}
        run: |
          artifact="tests/multicast/artifacts/binary-${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}-arm64"
          mkdir -p "${artifact}"
          container="$(docker create --network none "udm-iptv-multicast:${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}")"
          trap 'docker rm "${container}" >/dev/null' EXIT
          docker cp "${container}:/opt/proxy/." "${artifact}/"
          docker image inspect "udm-iptv-multicast:${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" > "${artifact}/image.json"
          cp tests/multicast/artifacts/runner.txt "${artifact}/runner.txt"
          cp tests/multicast/artifacts/build.log "${artifact}/build.log"
          if [[ "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" == patched ]]; then
            cp -R patches/improxy "${artifact}/patch-sources"
          fi
          jq -n --arg commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" --arg implementation "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" \
            --arg run "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --arg attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            '{commit: $commit, implementation: $implementation, run: $run, attempt: $attempt}' \
            > "${artifact}/provenance.json"
          (
            cd "${artifact}"
            mapfile -d '' -t files < <(find . -type f -print0 | sort -z)
            sha256sum "${files[@]}" > SHA256SUMS
          )
      - name: Run five-second multicast smoke test
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          python3 tests/multicast/run.py smoke \
            --implementation "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" \
            --proxy-version "${IGMP_VERSION}" --receiver-version "${IGMP_VERSION}" \
            --query-version "${IGMP_VERSION}"
      - name: Run six-minute regression scenario
        timeout-minutes: 8
        run: |
          python3 tests/multicast/run.py scenario \
            --implementation "${PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION}" \
            --scenario "${SCENARIO}" --duration 360 \
            --proxy-version "${IGMP_VERSION}" --receiver-version "${IGMP_VERSION}" \
            --query-version "${IGMP_VERSION}"
      - name: Upload regression evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: multicast-regression-${{ inputs.implementation }}-${{ matrix.scenario }}-v${{ matrix.version }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: tests/multicast/artifacts/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

name: Provider networks
on:

  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: { contents: read }

  refresh:
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/udm-iptv'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7

      - name: Extract the catalog providers' prefixes from IPinfo Lite
        env: { IPINFO_TOKEN: "${{ secrets.IPINFO_TOKEN }}" }
        run: go run ./cmd/providernetworks
      - name: Open a pull request when the table changed
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", BASE: "${{ github.ref_name }}" }
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet -- internal/config/provider_networks.txt.gz; then
            echo "provider networks unchanged"
            exit 0
          fi
          branch="provider-networks/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git switch -c "${branch}"
          git commit -am "Refresh provider networks from IPinfo Lite"
          git push origin "+HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}"
          gh pr create --base "${BASE}" --head "${branch}" --title "Refresh provider networks from IPinfo Lite" \
            --body "Regenerated by the Provider networks workflow with go run ./cmd/providernetworks." \
            || echo "::warning::Pull request creation was refused; open one for ${branch} by hand."

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Release
on: { push: { tags: ["v*"] } }
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  ci:
    uses: $/.github/workflows/ci.yml
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: read, pull-requests: read }
    with: { release: true }

  attest:
    name: Attest tested artifacts
    needs: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write, attestations: write, artifact-metadata: write }
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: "${{ needs.ci.outputs.artifact }}", path: dist }
      - name: Verify checksums
        working-directory: dist
        run: sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
      - name: Attest Packages
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/udm-iptv-linux-arm64
            dist/*.deb
            dist/SHA256SUMS

  publish:
    name: Publish release
    needs: [ci, attest]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env: { GH_REPO: "${{ github.repository }}" }
    permissions: { contents: write }
    steps:
      - name: Download Attested Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: "${{ needs.ci.outputs.artifact }}", path: dist }
      - name: Publish Release
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF#"refs/tags/"}"
          assets=(dist/udm-iptv-linux-arm64 dist/*.deb dist/SHA256SUMS)
          for asset in "${assets[@]}"; do test -f "${asset}"; done

          prerelease=()
          latest=(--latest=true)
          case "${tag}" in
            *preview*|*rc*|*-alpha*|*beta*)
              prerelease=(--prerelease)
              latest=(--latest=false)
              ;;
            *) ;;
          esac

          previous=$(gh release list --limit 100 --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease |
            jq -r --arg tag "${tag}" --argjson pre "${#prerelease[@]}" \
              '[.[] | select(.tagName != $tag and .isDraft == false and ($pre != 0 or .isPrerelease == false))][0].tagName // empty')
          notes_start=()
          if [[ -n "${previous}" ]]; then
            notes_start=(--notes-start-tag "${previous}")
          fi

          state=$(gh release view "${tag}" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft 2>/dev/null || true)
          case "${state}" in
            "") gh release create "${tag}" --draft "${prerelease[@]}" "${latest[@]}" --generate-notes "${notes_start[@]}" --title "udm-iptv ${tag}" --verify-tag ;;
            true) ;;
            false)
              echo "Release ${tag} is already published."
              exit 0
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Unexpected release state: ${state}" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          gh release upload "${tag}" "${assets[@]}" --clobber
          gh release edit "${tag}" --draft=false "${prerelease[@]}" "${latest[@]}"

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: UniFi OS
on:
  schedule: [{ cron: "17 3 * * *" }]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model:
        description: Router model to refresh, or all discovered models.
        type: string
        default: all
      track:
        description: Firmware track to refresh.
        type: choice
        default: all
        options: [all, release, beta, pinned]
concurrency: { group: "unifi-os-${{ github.ref }}", cancel-in-progress: false }
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  build:
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml

  catalog:
    name: Catalog firmware
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.catalog.outputs.matrix }}
      has_images: ${{ steps.catalog.outputs.has_images }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache-dependency-path: go.sum }
      - name: Discover firmware by track
        id: catalog
        env:
          MODEL: ${{ inputs.model || 'all' }}
          REQUESTED_TRACK: ${{ inputs.track || 'all' }}
          IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/unifi-os
        run: |
          tracks=(release beta pinned)
          if [[ "${REQUESTED_TRACK}" != all ]]; then
            tracks=("${REQUESTED_TRACK}")
          fi
          matrix='{"include":[]}'
          for track in "${tracks[@]}"; do
            next=$(go run ./cmd/firmware --track "${track}" catalog --model "${MODEL}")
            matrix=$(jq -c --argjson next "${next}" --arg track "${track}" \
              '.include += ($next.include | map(. + {track: $track}))' <<< "${matrix}")
          done
          printf 'has_images=%s\n' "$(jq '.include | length > 0' <<< "${matrix}")" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'matrix=%s\n' "${matrix}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  images:
    if: needs.catalog.outputs.has_images == 'true'
    name: Refresh firmware (${{ matrix.model }}, ${{ matrix.track }})
    needs: [build, catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: write }
    strategy: { fail-fast: false, max-parallel: 4, matrix: "${{ fromJSON(needs.catalog.outputs.matrix) }}" }
    env:
      MODEL: ${{ matrix.model }}
      TRACK: ${{ matrix.track }}
      IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/unifi-os
      FIRMWARES: ${{ toJSON(matrix.firmwares) }}
      SRC: ${{ matrix.from }}
      DST: ${{ matrix.to }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - parallel:
          - name: Setup Go
            uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
            with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache-dependency-path: go.sum }
          - name: Download test package
            uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
            with: { name: "${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact }}", path: dist }
          - name: Install extraction tools
            run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y squashfs-tools
      - name: Build missing firmware images
        env: { CACHE: "${{ runner.temp }}/unifi-os" }
        run: go run ./cmd/firmware --track "${TRACK}" build
      - name: Test installation, reboot and offline recovery
        env: { UDM_IPTV_FIRMWARE_EVIDENCE: "${{ runner.temp }}/firmware-evidence" }
        run: go test -tags firmware -v -count=1 -timeout=20m ./tests/firmware
      - name: Publish and verify image aliases
        if: github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", GH_REPO: "${{ github.repository }}" }
        run: go run ./cmd/firmware --track "${TRACK}" publish
      - name: Upload firmware evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: firmware-publish-evidence-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/firmware-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/goreleaser/goreleaser@v2.18.1/www/static/schema.json
---
version: 2
project_name: udm-iptv

builds:
  - id: udm-iptv
    main: ./cmd/udm-iptv
    binary: "{{ .ProjectName }}"
    env: [CGO_ENABLED=0]
    goos: [linux]
    goarch: [arm64]
    flags:
      - -trimpath
      - -buildvcs=true
    ldflags:
      - -s
      - -w
      - -X main.version={{ .Version }}
      - -X {{ .ModulePath }}/internal/telemetry.DSN={{ index .Env "SENTRY_DSN" }}

archives:
  - id: binary
    ids: [udm-iptv]
    formats: [binary]
    name_template: "{{ .ProjectName }}-{{ .Os }}-{{ .Arch }}"

nfpms:
  - id: debian
    ids: [udm-iptv]
    package_name: "{{ .ProjectName }}"
    file_name_template: "{{ .PackageName }}-{{ .Arch }}"
    vendor: '{{ if index .Env "GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER" }}{{ .Env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER }}{{ else }}{{ index (split .ModulePath "/") 1 }}{{ end }}'
    homepage: '{{ if index .Env "GITHUB_REPOSITORY" }}{{ .Env.GITHUB_SERVER_URL }}/{{ .Env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY }}{{ else }}https://{{ .ModulePath }}{{ end }}'
    maintainer: Kaj Kowalski <info@kajkowalski.nl>
    description: Routed IPTV for UniFi OS.
    license: GPL-2.0-or-later
    formats: [deb]
    bindir: /data/udm-iptv/bin
    section: net
    priority: optional
    dependencies: ["busybox | busybox-static", iptables, improxy, util-linux]
    suggests: ["igmpproxy (>= 0.2)"]
    contents:
      - { src: ./packaging/deb/copyright, dst: /usr/share/doc/udm-iptv/copyright }
      - { src: ./packaging/deb/go-package, dst: /usr/share/udm-iptv/go-package }
      - { src: ./packaging/deb/udm-iptv-completion.sh, dst: /etc/profile.d/udm-iptv-completion.sh }
    scripts:
      preinstall: ./packaging/deb/preinstall
      postinstall: ./packaging/deb/postinstall
      preremove: ./packaging/deb/preremove
      postremove: ./packaging/deb/postremove
    deb:
      compression: xz
      predepends: [debconf]
      scripts:
        config: ./packaging/deb/config
        templates: ./packaging/deb/templates
      fields: { Bugs: https://github.com/kjanat/udm-iptv/issues }

snapshot: { version_template: "{{ incpatch .Version }}-SNAPSHOT-{{ .ShortCommit }}" }
checksum: { name_template: SHA256SUMS }
changelog: { disable: true }
release: { draft: true, name_template: "{{ .ProjectName }} {{ .Tag }}" }
files.README.md:
# udm-iptv

Routed IPTV for UniFi OS, persistent across firmware updates.

## Install

Install the latest release on the console:

```sh
curl -fLO https://github.com/kjanat/udm-iptv/releases/latest/download/udm-iptv-arm64.deb
sudo apt install ./udm-iptv-arm64.deb
```

Installation verifies stable proxy readiness before reporting success.

### Standalone binary

```sh
curl -fLO https://github.com/kjanat/udm-iptv/releases/latest/download/udm-iptv-linux-arm64
curl -fLO https://github.com/kjanat/udm-iptv/releases/latest/download/SHA256SUMS
sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS
chmod +x udm-iptv-linux-arm64
sudo ./udm-iptv-linux-arm64 install
```

`install --dry-run` previews without root, changes, telemetry or health checks.

`--non-interactive` skips prompts. `apt install` performs real installation.

Configuration: `/data/udm-iptv/config.json`. Legacy settings migrate automatically.

Missing system proxies use preserved binaries and libraries offline.

### Upgrade from v4

On v4.3.2, upgrade to the Go preview with:

```sh
udm-iptv upgrade --prerelease
```

Older v4: run `udm-iptv upgrade` first.

Existing settings and matching v4 IPTV VLANs migrate automatically.

See [v4 upgrade details](docs/troubleshooting.md#upgrade-from-v4).

## Commands

```sh
udm-iptv configure
udm-iptv status
udm-iptv diagnose
udm-iptv start
udm-iptv stop
udm-iptv restart
udm-iptv upgrade
udm-iptv uninstall
```

`stop --for 30m` starts IPTV again after thirty minutes.

`status` shows when a pause ends.

`start` resumes early; running services remain uninterrupted.

`restart`, `stop` and uninstall cancel scheduled starts.

Uninstall retains `/data/udm-iptv/.lock`, protecting later installations from concurrent changes.

Unrelated files survive package purge.

`uninstall` or `uninstall --purge` removes persisted installation data.

`--keep-data` preserves generated data, including diagnostic captures.

`--keep-config` retains configuration while removing diagnostics.

Retention options cannot be combined.

dpkg still removes its packaged executable.

Pauses end at reboot; automatic startup still applies.

Failed scheduling attempts recovery and reports the outcome.

`upgrade --dry-run` shows what would be installed.

Preview builds automatically follow prereleases.

Stable builds follow stable releases unless `--prerelease` is supplied.

Downgrades require `--force`.

See `udm-iptv <command> --help` for options.

## Diagnostics

Record diagnostics for 30 minutes:

```sh
udm-iptv diagnose --capture 30m --format both --follow
```

Captures default to text and JSON Lines.

One-shot diagnosis defaults to text.

`diag` aliases `diagnose`; `--format json` aliases `--format jsonl`.

`--format text` or `--format jsonl` selects one capture format.

`q` or Ctrl-C closes the viewer; capture continues.

Private reports: `/data/udm-iptv/diagnostics` (0600), including addresses and raw logs.

Export complete capture evidence locally; the original stays unchanged:

```sh
udm-iptv diagnose export /data/udm-iptv/diagnostics/CAPTURE.jsonl >share.jsonl
udm-iptv diagnose export /data/udm-iptv/diagnostics/CAPTURE.jsonl --format text >share.txt
```

See [diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md) for retained evidence, collection limits and export formats.

Bounded journal events appear live; closing the viewer preserves capture.

See [telemetry details](docs/telemetry.md) for optional reliability reports.

See [startup troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) for DHCP and VLAN failures.

## Providers

[Provider profiles](docs/providers) supply editable defaults. [KPN specifications](docs/providers/kpn.md).

First setup suggests a provider from your address; confirm it.

Saved settings remain unchanged until you accept the review.

## Development

```sh
go test -race ./...
go vet ./...
go run ./cmd/udm-iptv preview
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=true -o dist/udm-iptv-linux-arm64 ./cmd/udm-iptv
goreleaser release --snapshot --clean --skip=publish
```

`preview` uses example data without system changes or telemetry.

CI builds binaries; routers need no Go toolchain.

## License

GPL-2.0-or-later. See [COPYING.txt](COPYING.txt).

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

export container=docker

# Keep the firmware's own /etc underneath the persistent writable overlay.
lower=/run/udm-iptv-test/etc-lower
overlay=/var/lib/udm-iptv-test/etc-overlay
mkdir -p "${lower}" "${overlay}/upper" "${overlay}/work"
mount --bind /etc "${lower}"
mount --bind -o remount,ro "${lower}"
mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=${lower},upperdir=${overlay}/upper,workdir=${overlay}/work" /etc

# Only hardware interfaces are simulated. The service and proxy are real.
# eth8 is one end of a veth pair so a DHCP server can answer on the other.
for iface in br0 eth0 eth1 eth2 eth3 eth4 eth9 eth18 eth19; do
	if ! ip link show "${iface}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		ip link add "${iface}" type dummy
	fi
	ip link set "${iface}" up
done
if ! ip link show eth8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	ip link add eth8 type veth peer name eth8-peer
fi
ip link set eth8 up
ip link set eth8-peer up
ip address replace 192.0.2.1/24 dev br0

# A provider-side DHCP server on VLAN 4 behind eth8: one lease pool, an
# RFC3442 route and no router option, the way KPN's IPTV network answers.
if [ "${UDM_IPTV_TEST_DHCP:-0}" = 1 ]; then
	command -v dnsmasq >/dev/null || {
		echo "udm-iptv-test: dnsmasq is missing from this firmware" >&2
		exit 1
	}
	if ! ip link show eth8-peer.4 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		ip link add link eth8-peer name eth8-peer.4 type vlan id 4
	fi
	ip link set eth8-peer.4 up
	ip address replace 10.207.64.1/20 dev eth8-peer.4
	dnsmasq --interface=eth8-peer.4 --bind-interfaces --except-interface=lo --port=0 \
		--dhcp-range=10.207.64.10,10.207.64.20,1h --dhcp-authoritative \
		--dhcp-option=option:classless-static-route,213.75.112.0/21,10.207.64.1 \
		--dhcp-option=option:router \
		--log-dhcp --log-facility=/run/udm-iptv-test/dnsmasq.log --pid-file=/run/udm-iptv-test/dnsmasq.pid
fi

# Exercise the preserved real proxy when firmware no longer supplies it.
if [ "${UDM_IPTV_TEST_ERASE_PROXY:-0}" = 1 ]; then
	if proxy=$(command -v improxy); then
		mv "${proxy}" /run/udm-iptv-test/firmware-improxy
	fi
fi

# Honor existing enablement. Never install, enable or start udm-iptv here.
target=udm-iptv-test.target
mkdir -p "/run/systemd/system/${target}.wants"
for enabled in /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/*; do
	[ -L "${enabled}" ] || continue
	name=$(basename "${enabled}")
	firmware_link="${lower}/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/${name}"
	if [ -e "${firmware_link}" ] || [ -L "${firmware_link}" ]; then
		continue
	fi
	unit=$(readlink -f "${enabled}")
	if [ -e "${enabled}" ]; then
		case ${unit} in
			/etc/systemd/system/*) ;;
			*) continue ;;
		esac
	fi
	ln -sf "${unit}" "/run/systemd/system/${target}.wants/${name}"
done

if [ -x /lib/systemd/systemd ]; then
	exec /lib/systemd/systemd --system --unit="${target}"
fi
exec /sbin/init --unit="${target}"

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
ARG FIRMWARE_IMAGE=ghcr.io/kjanat/unifi-os:udmpro-5.1.33@sha256:5d6138dd461c4d265380eb550f5e609b072268e50205007cdd050d09f1d38bf8
FROM --platform=linux/arm64 ${FIRMWARE_IMAGE} AS vendor

FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3 iproute2 tcpdump procps util-linux binutils ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /lab
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
COPY *.py /lab/
RUN python3 -m unittest -v test_fixture
ENTRYPOINT ["python3", "/lab/lab.py"]

FROM tools AS source
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl gcc make libc6-dev patch \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ARG IMPROXY_COMMIT=5a9d153d10e19ef835af9fc5f2a971799677a7ed
RUN curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://codeload.github.com/haibbo/improxy/tar.gz/${IMPROXY_COMMIT}" \
    -o /tmp/improxy.tar.gz \
    && mkdir /src && tar -xzf /tmp/improxy.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C /src \
    && printf '%s\n' "${IMPROXY_COMMIT}" > /src/revision

FROM source AS source-build
RUN make -C /src CC=gcc

FROM tools AS upstream
COPY --from=source-build /src/improxy /opt/proxy/improxy
COPY --from=source-build /src/revision /opt/proxy/revision
ENV PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION=upstream

FROM source AS patched-build
COPY --from=improxy_patch / /patches/improxy/
RUN cd /src \
    && patch -p1 --fuzz=0 < /patches/improxy/0001-ipv4-querier-election.patch \
    && bash /patches/improxy/test.sh /src \
    && make -B CC=gcc LDFLAGS=-static \
    && { cat revision; sha256sum /patches/improxy/*.patch; } > /tmp/revision \
    && mv /tmp/revision revision \
    && { gcc --version; ld --version; \
         dpkg-query -W gcc libc6-dev binutils; \
         printf '%s\n' 'make -B CC=gcc LDFLAGS=-static'; \
         sha256sum /tmp/improxy.tar.gz improxy; \
         find /patches/improxy -type f -exec sha256sum {} +; \
       } > /src/build-metadata.txt

FROM tools AS patched
COPY --from=patched-build /src/improxy /opt/proxy/improxy
COPY --from=patched-build /src/revision /opt/proxy/revision
COPY --from=patched-build /src/build-metadata.txt /opt/proxy/build-metadata.txt
COPY --from=patched-build /tmp/improxy.tar.gz /opt/proxy/upstream-source.tar.gz
ENV PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION=patched

# No vendor program runs during the build. Keep the original loader and libraries.
FROM tools AS firmware
ARG FIRMWARE_IMAGE
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.base.name=${FIRMWARE_IMAGE}
COPY --from=vendor /usr/sbin/improxy /opt/proxy/improxy
COPY --from=vendor /lib/ /opt/proxy/lib/
COPY --from=vendor /usr/lib/ /opt/proxy/usr/lib/
COPY --from=vendor /var/lib/dpkg/status /opt/proxy/package-status
RUN printf '%s\n' "${FIRMWARE_IMAGE}" > /opt/proxy/revision
ENV PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION=firmware

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run the Go registration regression against an already-built multicast image.
set -euo pipefail

implementation="${1:-upstream}"
case "${implementation}" in
	upstream | patched | firmware) ;;
	*)
		echo "Expected upstream, patched, or firmware" >&2
		exit 2
		;;
esac

cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.."
image="udm-iptv-multicast:${implementation}"
case "$(uname -m)" in
	aarch64 | arm64) host_arch=arm64 ;;
	x86_64 | amd64) host_arch=amd64 ;;
	*)
		echo "Unsupported native architecture" >&2
		exit 2
		;;
esac
image_arch="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Architecture}}' "${image}")"
if [[ "${host_arch}" != "${image_arch}" ]]; then
	echo "Native execution required: host ${host_arch}, image ${image_arch}" >&2
	exit 2
fi

mkdir -p tests/multicast/artifacts
evidence="$(mktemp -d "${PWD}/tests/multicast/artifacts/registration-${implementation}-XXXXXX")"
echo "Registration evidence: ${evidence}"
container="$(docker create --network none "${image}")"
trap 'docker rm "${container}" >/dev/null' EXIT
# The container is never started; the Go test owns private network/mount namespaces.
docker cp "${container}:/opt/proxy/improxy" "${evidence}/improxy"
docker cp "${container}:/opt/proxy/revision" "${evidence}/revision"
docker image inspect "${image}" >"${evidence}/image.json"
uname -a >"${evidence}/kernel.txt"
sha256sum "${evidence}/improxy" >"${evidence}/improxy.sha256"
go test -c -tags integration -o "${evidence}/service.test" ./internal/service

test_command=(env "UDM_IPTV_TEST_IMPROXY=${evidence}/improxy" "${evidence}/service.test"
	-test.run '^TestProxyRegistrationRejectsPartialStartup$' -test.v -test.timeout 45s)
registration_uid="$(id -u)"
if [[ "${registration_uid}" == 0 ]]; then
	"${test_command[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "${evidence}/test.log"
else
	sudo -n "${test_command[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "${evidence}/test.log"
fi

"""Host-side launcher: guard native architecture, retain provenance, remove its container."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path


def normalized_architecture(value):
    return {
        "aarch64": "arm64",
        "arm64": "arm64",
        "x86_64": "amd64",
        "amd64": "amd64",
    }.get(value, value)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["smoke", "scenario"])
    parser.add_argument(
        "--implementation",
        choices=["upstream", "firmware", "patched"],
        default="upstream",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--firmware-image")
    args, options = parser.parse_known_args()
    directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    environment = dict(os.environ, PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION=args.implementation)
    if args.firmware_image:
        environment["FIRMWARE_IMAGE"] = args.firmware_image
    compose = ["docker", "compose", "-f", str(directory / "compose.yaml")]
    info = json.loads(
        subprocess.check_output(["docker", "info", "--format", "{{json .}}"], text=True)
    )
    architecture = normalized_architecture(info["Architecture"])
    if args.implementation == "firmware" and architecture != "arm64":
        parser.error(
            "firmware requires a native ARM64 Docker daemon; QEMU user mode cannot implement its multicast sockets"
        )
    image_name = "udm-iptv-multicast:" + args.implementation
    image = json.loads(
        subprocess.check_output(["docker", "image", "inspect", image_name], text=True)
    )[0]
    if normalized_architecture(image["Architecture"]) != architecture:
        parser.error(
            "fixture image must match the Docker daemon architecture; rebuild without --platform"
        )
    if args.implementation == "firmware":
        config = json.loads(
            subprocess.check_output(
                [*compose, "config", "--format", "json"],
                env=environment,
                text=True,
            )
        )
        requested = config["services"]["lab"]["build"]["args"]["FIRMWARE_IMAGE"]
        built_from = (
            image["Config"].get("Labels", {}).get("org.opencontainers.image.base.name")
        )
        if requested != built_from:
            parser.error("built firmware differs from FIRMWARE_IMAGE; rebuild first")
    artifacts = directory / "artifacts"
    artifacts.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    name = "iptv-multicast-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
    provenance = {
        "image_id": image["Id"],
        "image_architecture": image["Architecture"],
        "daemon_architecture": architecture,
        "daemon_kernel": info["KernelVersion"],
        "engine_version": info["ServerVersion"],
        "implementation": args.implementation,
        "command": [args.mode, *options],
    }
    (artifacts / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n")
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                *compose,
                "run",
                "--rm",
                "--no-deps",
                "--name",
                name,
                "lab",
                args.mode,
                *options,
            ],
            env=environment,
            check=False,
        )
        return completed.returncode
    finally:
        # Only this invocation's named container; no project-wide or image cleanup.
        subprocess.run(
            ["docker", "rm", "-f", name],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            check=False,
            timeout=15,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
